I begin subtly shitlording at this time, before even knowing that was a thing. This friend unconsciously encouraged me to wear shorter shorts and tighter tops. I love munching carrots; she hated carrots and let me know often. Sometimes I'd splurge and eat three fast food bean burritos and she'd make some snide comment about "where they went" except that'd be all I'd eaten all day. We'd plan a lunch date and I'd eat accordingly to what I was going to have (ie coffee and an apple for breakfast, no lunch, or coffee for breakfast and carrots for lunch) so I could get steak and potatoes. Judgemental comments abound on how I could "eat like her" and "look like me" abounded.

My shitlording kicked up a notch.
